moves.name: Bullet Seed
moves.description: Attacks the target two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Unbreakable Swords Dance
moves.description:
Activation Condition: When weather, terrain, or zone effects are activated.
Deactivation Condition: When all weather, terrain, and zone effects are cleared.

Raises the Attack of all allied sync pairs by 2 stat ranks. Increases the Physical Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by 1 rank. Charges the user’s move gauge by 2 when the weather is sunny.

moves.name: Now I’m Angry!
moves.description: Raises the Defense of all allied sync pairs by 2 stat ranks. Raises the critical-hit rate of all allied sync pairs by 3 stat ranks. Raises the Speed of all allied sync pairs by 2 stat ranks when the weather is sunny.

passives.name: Guardian’s Abundance
passives.description: Reduces special attack move damage taken by allies when the weather is sunny. Extends the duration of sunny weather when the weather turns sunny while the user is on the field. Turns the field of play’s terrain into Grassy Terrain the first time the user uses Sunny Day each battle.

subPassives.name: 1st Use Sunny Day: Grassy Terrain
subPassives.description: Turns the field of play’s terrain into Grassy Terrain the first time the user uses Sunny Day each battle.

subPassives.name: Drought Alert 3
subPassives.description: Extends the duration of sunny weather when the weather turns sunny while the user is on the field.

subPassives.name: Sunny: Team Special DR 3
subPassives.description: Reduces special attack move damage taken by allies when the weather is sunny.

passives.name: Grassy Terrain Debut & Extension 5
passives.description: Turns the field of play’s terrain into Grassy Terrain the first time the user enters a battle each battle. Extends the duration of Grassy Terrain when the terrain turns into Grassy Terrain while the user is on the field.

passives.name: Team Verdant Physical DR 3
passives.description: Reduces physical attack move damage taken by allies when the terrain is Grassy Terrain.

passives.name: Ula’ula Ocean Breeze
passives.description: Has a chance (100%) of increasing the Physical Moves ↑ Next effect of all allied sync pairs by 1 rank when an ally activates a weather, terrain, or zone effect.

cells.title: Sunscreen 1
cells.description: Reduces damage when the user is hit by an attack move while the weather is sunny.

cells.title: Bullet Seed: Recharging Strike 2
cells.description: Has a chance (30%) of charging the user’s move gauge by one when its attack move hits. If the move has the multistrike effect tag, has a chance (30%) of charging the user’s move gauge by one for each hit.

cells.title: Bullet Seed: Punishing Strike 2
cells.description: Has a chance (30%) of lowering the target’s Defense by 1 stat rank when the user’s attack move against it hits. If the move has the multistrike effect tag, has a chance (30%) of lowering the target’s Defense by 1 stat rank for each hit.

cells.title: Natural Remedy
cells.description: Removes all status conditions from the user the first time it is inflicted by any status condition each battle.

cells.title: Adrenaline 1
cells.description: Reduces the sync move countdown by 1 the first time the user’s sync move is used each battle.
